rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty about TE uniformity/cohesiveness and zona thinning/symmetry from this single image; some described details are not clearly discernible.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, male factor, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though a few inferences go beyond the provided data.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include speculative quantitative penalties and some overconfident assumptions.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice, especially eSET for a young patient with a high-quality Day-5 blastocyst and lifestyle optimization; slight deviations include speculative ERA use and some unsupported specifics.

Provides clear practical steps for transfer and future planning, including eSET, smoking cessation, weight/exercise advice, and when to consider further testing, though some suggestions are more advisory than protocol-specific.
